rows.grounds: fused sandhi form tathā tatheti arthaḥ

items.question: What meaning is assigned when things are applied in collection thus and as thus?
premises: Thus and as thus describe correspondence.
items.inference: The verse states that in collection, applied things are understood as thus and thus.
uncertainties: The exact sandhi expansion of tathā tathetyarthaḥ is editorially fused.
items.plain_english: And in collection, as things are applied thus and thus, so is the meaning.
